This is an alphabetical '''list of countries by past and projected [[gross domestic product]]''', based on the [[purchasing power parity]] (PPP) methodology, not on market exchange rates. These figures have been taken from the [[International Monetary Fund]]'s [[World Economic Outlook]] (WEO) Database, April 2026 Edition.<ref name="IMF Data">{{Cite web|title=World Economic Outlook Database April 2026|url=https://data.imf.org/en/Data-Explorer?datasetUrn=IMF.RES:WEO(9.0.0)|access-date=2026-04-15|website=www.imf.org}}</ref> The figures are given or expressed in Millions of [[International Dollars]] at current prices.
__TOC__

=== 2020s ===
The following list contains the various countries' projected GDP (PPP) from 2020 to 2029.
